$comment: UI-hints registry. The allowed vocabulary of declarative presentation affordances a part/section form field may carry in its `uiHints` block, plus the contract for each. These are PRESENTATION hints over the clean instance-data model — they never change the data shape (dataPath/uiType/codelist) and are safe for a renderer to ignore. The compiler (model/compiler/parts.mjs) validates every field `uiHints` against this registry. Keep this list closed so a typo'd hint fails the build rather than silently doing nothing.

ted-notice.$comment: A 'look up from TED' affordance: the field value (a TED notice number or a notice URL) is used to fetch the published notice and prefill Part I. Replaces the legacy hard-coded enhancePartIWithLookup() in js/renderer.js, which keyed off fixed contentpaths; here it is declared on the model field and the renderer stays generic. Regulation 2016/7 Part I anticipates this auto-retrieval for OJEU-published procedures.
ted-notice.label: Look up

reads.$comment: Which kind of value the field carries, so the client knows how to resolve it against the TED API.

prefills.$comment: Instance dataPaths the lookup result may populate on success. The renderer writes resolved values here (leaving them editable). Mirrors the fields a TED notice carries that map onto Part I Sections B and C.

failureMode.$comment: When the notice cannot be fetched (offline, unknown number), the prefilled fields MUST remain manually editable — the lookup is a convenience, never a gate.
